blocks.text: AI Security groups common threats into different categories. The policy violations are associated with a specific threat category and a severity level, allowing you to analyze the issue and take the necessary action.
AI Security defines the following threat categories:

table: AI breach due to misconfigurations or vulnerabilities (e.g., encryption or logging is disabled on the resource, backup feature disabled).
Exposure of unsafe responses to users (e.g., instructions about self harm).
Improperly configured or risky model issues that can lead to vulnerabilities.
User credentials are not secure (e.g., users without MFA).
